item.title: AI controls fusion plasma faster than humans
item.description: Princeton researchers tested an AI that monitors and controls fusion plasma in milliseconds, outpacing human reaction times.

item.title: Indonesia's dangerous underground fires surge
item.description: Indonesia's peat fires are increasing early in the 2026 season due to El Niño and drought drying wetlands.

item.title: 80,000-year-old arrowheads challenge historical timeline
item.description: Tiny projectile points found in Uzbekistan, dating back 80,000 years, may have functioned as arrowheads, suggesting earlier advanced weaponry.

item.title: Earth's signal may point to dark matter
item.description: Using Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere as a large detector, scientists searched for ultra-light dark matter candidates, with potential clues emerging.
